agent_explanation: Shrunk scenario has a thin horizontal wall (w=5.5 h=0.2 at 9.6,9.4) and a fast body (vx≈-50, vy≈-17.5, r=0.5). At step 1 the body is just above the wall (distance_to_surface ≈0.023) with 22 substeps. At step 2 it penetrates to distance -0.228 (overlap 0.228 > 0.15 limit) despite substeps, indicating discrete collision/positional-correction fails for high-speed traversal over/through a wall thinner than the body diameter. Reducing horizontal speed removes the penetration, confirming speed-vs-thin-wall tunneling is the cause.
